comment: The base module ships Gray-Scott, a reaction and diffusion whose two concentrations are a field of its own. A disc is painted in one colour, Gray-Scott goes on the layer through `simulation` with its defaults, and two thousand steps are run, five hundred at a time. The shot at step 2000 is the record `check_shots.py` reads, since the seed is a hash of the texel and the steps are the same on every run from the same disc.
